name: Shemaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Because Shemaiah prophesied when the Lord sent him not and caused the people to trust in a lie, the Most High would punish him and his seed; he shall not have a man to dwell among the people nor behold the good the Lord will do, because he taught rebellion against the Lord.

note.label: Jeremiah 29: The Letter to the Captives
